# Let There Be

> Let There Be is a science marketing agency for healthcare and consumer-health brands. Since 2013 we have helped brands lead with scientific truth — pairing the Science Marketing Engine (a science-led strategy model) with the Science Studio (world-class video and animation production). Science leads; creativity makes it impossible to ignore.

## The Science Marketing Engine
- [Science Marketing Engine — overview](https://lettherebe.com/engine): The operating model where science leads strategy, creativity brings it to life, and the studio scales it everywhere.
- [Science Intelligence™](https://lettherebe.com/science-intelligence): Where Let There Be takes on any consumer-health question that comes down to evidence: literature reviews, claim development, competitor claim tracing, formulation and ingredient strategy, label and regulatory scope, and how supplement rating sites and AI assistants judge a category.
- [Lit Review™](https://lettherebe.com/lit-review): A review of the published science on every ingredient in a product, scoped to what the product is for and checked against what competitors claim, sorted into what is established, what is new, what is unclaimed and what does not hold up.
- [Claim Dev™](https://lettherebe.com/claim-dev): New claims written from the science: hero claims and supporting lines, branded and marketing-forward, for consumers and HCPs, in the register the category allows (structure/function for supplements, the monograph or label for OTC drugs, cleared intended use for devices, nutrient content rules for food).
- [Science Index™](https://lettherebe.com/science-index): Evidence-led articles and FAQs built from a brand's verified research and structured so search engines and AI assistants can find, read and cite the science behind a product.
- [Science Story™](https://lettherebe.com/science-story): Where research meets creative. A Science Story is a campaign idea built from a brand’s science: a headline, a story in the brand’s voice and the claims behind it. Three concepts are written and tested with consumers (purchase intent, believability, line-by-line likes and dislikes, claim ranking, head-to-head pick), and the winner is locked as the idea every team and partner briefs from.

## The Science Studio
- [Science Studio — overview](https://lettherebe.com/studio): Cinematic science production — MOA videos, social, HCP education, retail, TV and digital advertising, and conference/sales videos.
- [MOA Moment™](https://lettherebe.com/moa-moment): Mechanism-of-action explained in seconds — clear, compelling, compliant.
- [Science Carousel™](https://lettherebe.com/science-carousel): A five-to-six image science story for retail product pages (Amazon, Walmart and beyond), built so every image stands on its own because retailers control the display order.
- [Influencer Science Kit™](https://lettherebe.com/influencer-science-kit): Defensible, consumer-ready science language and visuals for creators.
- [Ad-to-Education Sequence™](https://lettherebe.com/ad-to-education): A 15-second ad earns the click; a 30-second education video earns the belief — on Amazon, Walmart, Chewy, and beyond.

## Company
- [Work & case studies](https://lettherebe.com/work): Results for Designs for Health, Cheers Health, iVIZIA, Nexium 24HR, Flonase, Lotrimin, Bausch + Lomb, and more.
- [About & team](https://lettherebe.com/about): Researchers, account managers, and animators — everyone here is fluent in science.
- [Contact](https://lettherebe.com/contact): Start a Science Story™.

## Guides
- [IngredientAI vs. Let There Be](https://lettherebe.com/ingredientai-vs-lettherebe): An honest comparison for supplement and consumer-health brands: IngredientAI is self-serve AI formulation software your team operates; Let There Be is a full-service team that runs the literature review, develops MLR-ready claims tied to verified source studies, consumer-tests the story, and produces the creative. Includes a side-by-side table and FAQ on choosing between claims software and a science marketing service.
